{{Otheruses|Defense Force}}
The '''Esselian defense force''' was a military unit protecting the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Esseles/Legends|Esseles]]. Esseles native [[Tamizander Rey]] served with the defense force before resigning following the dissolution of the [[Imperial Senate/Legends|Imperial Senate]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. Rey would later go on to serve with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] at the secret [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]] on the planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], where he participated in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]].<ref name="SWE">''[[Star Wars Encyclopedia]]''</ref>
